title: Mutual Funds Investment Platform
description: An intelligent fintech platform designed to simplify mutual fund investing through analytics, comparison tools, investor education, and advisor-driven insights.
purpose: This platform helps users understand, compare, and explore mutual funds intelligently by combining financial education, role-based dashboards, analytics, risk understanding, and advisor support.
findings: Financial dashboards need clarity before complexity.
Role-based flows make fintech platforms easier to trust.
Docker and API-driven structure improve production readiness.

title: Gold Price Prediction
description: A regression workflow that models gold price movement using statistical learning and feature-driven market signals.
purpose: Built to understand how supervised models can approximate commodity price behavior and support exploratory market analysis.
findings: Feature relationships matter more than raw trend chasing.
Tree-based models can capture non-linear price behavior.
Evaluation discipline keeps predictions grounded.

title: Heart Disease Analysis
description: An analytical machine learning study focused on identifying health indicators associated with heart disease risk.
purpose: Designed to explore medical feature patterns and build interpretable classification thinking around health-risk detection.
findings: EDA is crucial for understanding medically meaningful patterns.
Classification metrics need context beyond accuracy.
Visualization improves trust in model behavior.

title: Customer Segmentation K-Means
description: A clustering project that groups customers into behavioral segments for clearer marketing and business decisions.
purpose: Built to uncover customer groups through unsupervised learning and translate raw behavioral data into useful business personas.
findings: Segmentation turns noisy behavior into actionable groups.
Scaling strongly affects clustering quality.
Business labels make model outputs usable.

title: Fraud Detection Machine Learning
description: A fraud-focused ML pipeline for identifying suspicious transaction behavior from imbalanced data.
purpose: Created to practice high-stakes classification, imbalance-aware evaluation, and signal extraction for risk detection systems.
findings: Precision and recall tradeoffs matter deeply in fraud systems.
Class imbalance changes how success should be measured.
Detection work needs explainable thresholds.

title: BigMart Sales Prediction
description: A sales prediction workflow that studies retail demand patterns and builds models for revenue forecasting.
purpose: Built to connect analytics with business planning by predicting product-level sales behavior from retail data.
findings: Store and product attributes shape sales outcomes.
Feature preparation improves forecast stability.
Forecasting supports smarter inventory decisions.

title: Titanic Survival Prediction
description: A classic supervised learning project that predicts passenger survival using demographic and travel features.
purpose: Built to practice feature understanding, categorical preprocessing, and classification evaluation on a well-known survival dataset.
findings: Passenger attributes can reveal strong survival patterns.
Clean feature encoding improves model behavior.
Simple baselines are valuable before complex models.

title: Insurance Machine Learning
description: A predictive modeling workflow for analyzing insurance-related patterns and estimating outcome behavior.
purpose: Created to connect business variables with model-driven estimates that can support insurance analytics and pricing intuition.
findings: Feature distributions influence prediction quality.
Regression framing supports business estimation.
Clear error metrics make outcomes understandable.

title: Car Price Prediction
description: A regression project that estimates car prices through cleaned vehicle attributes and model evaluation.
purpose: Built to understand how product attributes, preprocessing, and supervised learning combine in price prediction systems.
findings: Vehicle features shape price variance strongly.
Outliers need careful treatment in regression.
Readable visuals improve market interpretation.

title: Wine Quality Testing
description: A data science project for evaluating wine quality signals through chemical attributes and model-based analysis.
purpose: Created to practice classification-style thinking, correlation analysis, and feature interpretation in product quality data.
findings: Chemical attributes create measurable quality signals.
Correlation plots expose useful feature relationships.
Model metrics help translate quality into decisions.

title: Diabetes Detection
description: A classification workflow focused on detecting diabetes risk patterns from patient health indicators.
purpose: Built to practice healthcare-oriented model design, evaluation discipline, and responsible interpretation of risk features.
findings: Healthcare classification needs metric-aware evaluation.
Feature scaling and cleaning affect reliability.
Risk detection benefits from transparent interpretation.

title: Rock vs Mine Prediction
description: A sonar-data classification project that separates rock and mine signatures through machine learning.
purpose: Built to explore signal-style datasets, binary classification, and evaluation on compact high-dimensional feature spaces.
findings: Small datasets need careful validation.
Signal features can support strong binary separation.
Simple models often establish useful baselines.

title: Autism Prediction Machine Learning
description: A classification study using screening and demographic features to predict autism likelihood with tree-based models.
purpose: Created to practice healthcare classification with preprocessing, imbalance handling, and model comparison across Decision Tree, Random Forest, and XGBoost classifiers.
findings: Healthcare screening models need clean categorical handling.
Class imbalance affects evaluation confidence.
Tree ensembles are useful for mixed feature spaces.

title: Breast Cancer Detection
description: A Logistic Regression classification notebook for detecting malignant/benign cancer patterns from diagnostic measurements.
purpose: Built to practice clinically oriented binary classification, feature scaling, and interpretable baseline modeling.
findings: Scaled numeric diagnostic features support strong linear baselines.
Healthcare models must be judged beyond simple accuracy.
Classification reports communicate precision and recall tradeoffs.

title: Movie Recommendation System
description: A content-based recommendation project using text feature extraction and cosine similarity to suggest related movies.
purpose: Created to understand recommender systems by converting movie metadata into vectors and ranking similar titles by semantic proximity.
findings: Text features can power useful recommendation baselines.
Fuzzy matching improves user input tolerance.
Similarity ranking turns metadata into a usable discovery system.

title: Rainfall Prediction
description: A Random Forest classification workflow for predicting rainfall outcomes from weather-related signals.
purpose: Built to practice environmental prediction with resampling, categorical preprocessing, and classifier evaluation.
findings: Weather prediction needs robust preprocessing before modeling.
Resampling can improve class balance.
Confusion matrices help explain false rain/no-rain decisions.

title: Spam Mail Detection
description: A text classification project using TF-IDF features and Logistic Regression to classify emails as spam or ham.
purpose: Created to practice NLP preprocessing, vectorization, and binary classification for communication safety.
findings: Text vectorization transforms raw email copy into model-ready features.
Logistic Regression is a strong baseline for sparse NLP features.
Spam detection needs attention to false positives.
